summary: 008 correctly proves reuse of existing candidate/check/admission semantics for same-candidate environment correction versus new-candidate repository correction, but it is not yet Proposal-ready. It incorrectly promotes flowkit-next's literal self-test six-gate command sequence into generic product delivery-full-test Guidance despite D04 external-project readiness requiring project-local tooling, and it leaves the legal authority source for the already-decided delivery-full-test operation unresolved even though accepted historical Full Test semantics require explicit Owner authorization. Revise only these Change 2 contract boundaries; no new Registry/Planner/lifecycle is justified.
